meta.name: gold_set_fund_3r
meta.structure: 10轮×6问(1初始+5追问)，仿 test_cases.json；不含宏观/EDB主题

sources.MYSQL-2: 生产 juling（真实数据，只读）
sources.MYSQL-1: 测试 Nacos FUND_INFO @192.168.15.57:31513（测试数据）
sources.MYSQL-4: 本地 fiu（43只美股样本，合成数值，gold以库内值为准）

judge_types.numeric: 数值必须命中(相对容差0.5%)；gold_date/gold_entities 若给出则必须命中
judge_types.entity: 实体必须命中；数值与日期为软校验(记录不计错)

initial.question: 华夏上证50ETF联接A基金2026年9月1日的单位净值是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT UNIT_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='001051.OF' AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-01'

feedbacks.question: 它同一天的累计净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ACCU_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='001051.OF' AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-01'

feedbacks.question: 华夏上证50ETF(510050)2026年9月1日的单位净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT UNIT_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='510050.SH' AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-01'

feedbacks.question: 易方达蓝筹精选混合2025年的年度收益率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT YIELD FROM FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='005827.OF' AND YEAR=2025

feedbacks.question: 2025年年度收益率最高的基金是哪只？收益率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 永赢科技智选混合发起A(022364.OF) +233.29%
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT FUND_SYMBOL, FUND_NAME, YIELD FROM FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR WHERE YEAR=2025 ORDER BY YIELD DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 天弘余额宝货币基金最新的资产净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT NET_VALUE FROM FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='000198.OF' ORDER BY REPORT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

initial.question: 易方达蓝筹精选混合2026年二季报的前三大重仓股是哪些？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT SEC_NAME, RATIO_IN_NV FROM FUND_PORTFOLIO_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='005827.OF' AND REPORT_DATE='2026-06-30' AND FUND_HOLDING_SOURCE_ID=1 ORDER BY MARKET_VALUE DESC LIMIT 3

feedbacks.question: 易方达蓝筹精选混合现在的基金经理都有谁？
feedbacks.gold_display: 张坤、杨思亮、何一铖（共管）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT PSN_NAME FROM FUND_AND_MANAGER_MAPPING WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='005827.OF' AND END_DATE IS NULL

feedbacks.question: 张坤目前在管的基金有几只？管理总规模是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT FUND_NUM_ACTUAL, NET_VALUE FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO WHERE PSN_NAME='张坤'

feedbacks.question: 全市场在管基金数量最多的基金经理是谁？管了几只？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT PSN_NAME, INST_NAME, FUND_NUM_ACTUAL FROM FUND_MANAGER_INFO ORDER BY FUND_NUM_ACTUAL DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 易方达蓝筹精选混合最新的资产净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT NET_VALUE FROM FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='005827.OF' ORDER BY REPORT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 全市场规模最大的基金是哪只？资产净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT FUND_SYMBOL, FUND_NAME, NET_VALUE FROM FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION WHERE REPORT_DATE='2026-06-30' ORDER BY NET_VALUE DESC LIMIT 1

initial.question: 华夏上证50ETF(510050)2026年9月2日的收盘价是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM ETF_PERFORMANCE_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='510050.SH' AND TYPE=1 AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-02'

feedbacks.question: 它当天的涨跌幅是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT CHANGE_PCT FROM ETF_PERFORMANCE_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='510050.SH' AND TYPE=1 AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-02'

feedbacks.question: 它2026年9月2日的基金规模是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT FUND_SIZE FROM ETF_PERFORMANCE_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='510050.SH' AND TYPE=1 AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-02'

feedbacks.question: 华夏上证50ETF今年以来（YTD）的收益率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT YTD FROM ETF_PERFORMANCE_DETAIL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='510050.SH' AND TYPE=1 AND TRADING_DAY='2026-09-02'

feedbacks.question: 目前境内的ETF一共有多少只？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ETF_INFO_DETAIL WHERE TYPE=1

feedbacks.question: 其中QDII类型的ETF有多少只？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ETF_INFO_DETAIL WHERE IF_QDII=1
